job.title: Backend Engineering Intern (Python/FastAPI)
job.raw_text: We are looking for a Backend Engineering Intern proficient in Python and FastAPI to build clean REST APIs. You will work with SQL databases, write unit and integration tests, and help containerize services for deployment.

requirements.name: REST APIs
requirements.source_sentence: Proficient in Python and FastAPI to build clean REST APIs.

requirements.name: SQL Database
requirements.source_sentence: You will work with SQL databases.

latest_analysis.commit_message: Initial commit: FastAPI backend with in-memory store

assessments.summary: FastAPI application with multiple typed endpoints and Pydantic request models.
assessments.limitation: Endpoints operate over in-memory dictionaries without persistent storage.
assessments.next_step: Connect route handlers to a persistent SQL database layer.

assessments.summary: No SQL queries, database drivers, or ORM models found in the analyzed code.
assessments.limitation: README claims PostgreSQL and comment mentions '# TODO: add SQL', but no actual database code exists.
assessments.next_step: Add parameterized SQL queries or SQLite/PostgreSQL connection code in a dedicated database module.

ignored_signals.reason: README claims 'Built with PostgreSQL' without backing code (weak signal)
Code comment '# TODO: add SQL' earns no credit

assessments.summary: Test file exists but contains only trivial assertions that do not verify application behavior.
assessments.limitation: tests/test_smoke.py contains only 'assert True'; no project code is imported or asserted against.
assessments.next_step: Write pytest test cases importing app code and asserting HTTP status codes or return payloads.

assessments.summary: No containerization or deployment configurations discovered in analyzed files.
assessments.limitation: No Dockerfile, docker-compose.yml, Procfile, or cloud configuration files present.
assessments.next_step: Add a production Dockerfile containerizing the FastAPI service.

assessments.summary: Clean, idiomatic Python 3 codebase with standard type annotations and structured models.
assessments.limitation: Scope is limited to a single module with basic CRUD handlers.
assessments.next_step: Modularize handlers into separate router and service packages.
